answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that meets the mandated 18% reduction, while the incumbent refused repricing and expires in 14 days. Verify the vendor’s prior quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, plus the archived evidence that a second source can protect constrained supply. Execute a guarded transition rather than an unqualified broad rollout because the line is at 94% of committed volume with no buffer; require delivery and quality checkpoints before expanding the vendor’s share.
